elements.describe: The cap on the translucent coolant expansion tank, with a filler neck marked MAX and MIN; reported on the passenger side toward the firewall.
The washer-fluid filler neck cap, reported black with a wiper symbol, serving window and headlamp washers.
The engine oil filler neck cap on top of the engine.
The brake fluid reservoir at the driver-side base of the windshield, hidden under a long plastic cover.
The base of the windshield and wiper arms for orientation.
Unestablished detail of coolant expansion tank cap: Exact tank shape, cap color and whether marks are on the tank side or filler neck conflict; depict a generic translucent tank.
Unestablished detail of brake reservoir under cover: The reservoir is hidden; do not show cover screw count or the reservoir's cap markings.
Unestablished detail of washer fluid filler cap: Side is supported (passenger) but exact position and cap colour (black vs blue) are not; show a filler on the passenger side without colour.
